name: Napa County Health and Human Services
description: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Napa County residents.
fullDescription: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Napa County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications and recertification
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children
- Adult and aging services, including IHSS
howToGetIt: Apply online at BenefitsCal.com any time, or call either number below to start an application by phone.
keywords: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, food stamps, CalWORKs, benefits office, apply, Napa County, health and human services
